Name: Slim Catalogue Doors - PIF
Author: pheauxm
Description: Adds slimmer (1-tile wide and without frames) versions of the vanilla doors found in furniture catalogues using Content Patcher. Doors do not replace existing doors and are automatically added to their respective catalogues. Total of 10 new doors that are all usable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url]﻿ if it's installed, otherwise they'll solely be decorative.
